subject.title: fix(embeddings): honor request.allowPrivateNetwork for OpenAI-compatible embedding provider

question: Should `models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` remain a provider-wide opt-in when a runtime `remote.baseUrl` selects a different endpoint, or must private-network permission be scoped to that effective remote endpoint?
rationale: This is an externally observable SSRF authorization boundary rather than a mechanical implementation detail; the existing setting name and shared resolver support the proposed broad semantics, but only maintainers can choose whether that is the permanent product contract.

options.title: Affirm provider-wide opt-in
options.body: Keep the shared resolver behavior, documenting that explicit `allowPrivateNetwork` authorizes private traffic for both configured and runtime-overridden endpoints.

options.title: Scope permission to remote endpoint
options.body: Define a remote-level request-policy contract and keep the configured provider setting from widening access when a different remote base URL is selected.

recommendation.title: Affirm provider-wide opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the shared resolver behavior, documenting that explicit `allowPrivateNetwork` authorizes private traffic for both configured and runtime-overridden endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: The current patch author can clarify the intended implementation and update the branch after maintainer direction, though the final contract decision belongs to a repository owner.
